---
title: "Severe Crises. Silent Headlines."
subtitle: Tracking where suffering is high and global attention is low
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    scrolling: true
    theme: [darkly, brand.scss]
    logo: logo.png
    embed-resources: true
output-file: index.html
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(reactable)
library(readr)

# ---- Brand -------------------------------------------------------------
anthracite <- "#2B2B2E"
card_grey  <- "#36363A"
deep_grey  <- "#1F1F21"
line_grey  <- "#45454A"
gold       <- "#AF8B2F"   # GOLD: website uses #B5943F
gold_light <- "#C9AA58"
gold_pale  <- "#F0D48A"
text_light <- "#E8E6E1"
trend_colours <- c("#FFF1C4", gold, text_light, "#E0BE62", "#8C8C92", gold_light, "#B8B0A4", "#7A6328")
trend_dashes  <- c("solid", "solid", "dash", "dash", "dot", "dot", "dashdot", "dashdot")

chart_font <- list(color = text_light, family = "DM Sans, sans-serif")
dark_axis  <- list(gridcolor = line_grey, zerolinecolor = line_grey,
                   linecolor = line_grey, tickfont = chart_font)

# Dates written in English whatever the computer's language
month_label <- function(ym) paste(month.name[as.integer(substr(ym, 6, 7))], substr(ym, 1, 4))
date_label  <- function(d) paste(as.integer(format(d, "%d")),
                                 month.abb[as.integer(format(d, "%m"))], format(d, "%Y"))

# ---- Severity (ACAPS INFORM): decides the countries AND the month ------
severity <- read_csv("data/severity.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
im <- unique(severity$inform_month)
if (length(im) != 1) stop("severity.csv contains more than one INFORM month. Re-run 03_inform.R.")
ref_month <- sprintf("%s-%02d", substr(im, 4, 7), match(substr(im, 1, 3), month.abb))
ref_label <- month_label(ref_month)

# ---- News attention (GDELT): locked to the INFORM month ----------------
attention_all <- read_csv("data/attention_monthly.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
if (!"iso3" %in% names(attention_all)) {             # old 5-country test file
  attention_all <- attention_all |>
    mutate(iso3 = recode(country, Sudan = "SDN", DRC = "COD", Haiti = "HTI",
                         Myanmar = "MMR", Ukraine = "UKR"))
}
if (!ref_month %in% attention_all$month) {
  stop("GDELT has no data for ", ref_label, ", the INFORM month. ",
       "Re-run the scripts so both sources cover the same month.")
}
attention <- attention_all |>
  filter(month == ref_month) |>
  select(iso3, attention = share_per_10k)

# ---- Funding (OCHA FTS): year-to-date ----------------------------------
funding_raw  <- read_csv("data/funding.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
funding_date <- if ("as_of" %in% names(funding_raw)) max(funding_raw$as_of) else
                  as.Date(file.info("data/funding.csv")$mtime)
funding <- select(funding_raw, iso3, funded_pct)

# ---- Combine -----------------------------------------------------------
neglect <- severity |>
  select(iso3, country, severity, top_crisis, crises) |>
  left_join(attention, by = "iso3") |>
  left_join(funding,   by = "iso3")

scatter_data <- neglect |>
  filter(!is.na(attention)) |>
  mutate(gap   = severity - log1p(attention),
         label = ifelse(rank(-severity, ties.method = "first") <= 8, country, ""),
         dot   = ifelse(label != "", gold_pale, gold))

top <- scatter_data |> arrange(desc(gap))

trend_iso <- neglect |> filter(!is.na(attention)) |>
  arrange(desc(severity)) |> slice_head(n = 8) |> pull(iso3)
trend_data <- attention_all |>
  filter(iso3 %in% trend_iso, month <= ref_month) |>
  select(iso3, month, share_per_10k) |>
  left_join(select(neglect, iso3, name = country), by = "iso3") |>
  arrange(month) |>
  mutate(month_lab = paste0(month.abb[as.integer(substr(month, 6, 7))], "-", substr(month, 3, 4)),
         month_lab = factor(month_lab, levels = unique(month_lab)))

value_style <- "font-family: Syne, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.7rem;"
```

## Row {height=480px}

```{r}
#| title: "Crisis severity map"
plot_ly(neglect, type = "choropleth", locations = ~iso3, z = ~severity,
        text = ~paste0(country, "<br>", top_crisis),
        hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>Severity: %{z:.1f}<extra></extra>",
        colorscale = list(c(0, "#6B5520"), c(0.35, gold), c(0.7, "#E0BE62"), c(1, "#FFF1C4")),
        colorbar = list(title = list(text = "Crisis<br>Severity<br>Score", side = "top", font = chart_font),
                        tickfont = chart_font, outlinewidth = 0,
                        x = 0.97, xanchor = "left", y = 0.5, yanchor = "middle",
                        len = 0.6, thickness = 20),
        marker = list(line = list(color = anthracite, width = 0.5))) |>
  layout(paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", font = chart_font,
         geo = list(bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", showframe = FALSE,
                    projection = list(type = "orthographic",
                                      rotation = list(lon = 20, lat = 10)),
                    showocean = TRUE, oceancolor = "#1A1A1C",
                    showland = TRUE, landcolor = "#3E3E44",
                    showcountries = TRUE, countrycolor = "#55555B",
                    showcoastlines = FALSE,
                    lonaxis = list(showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#2A2A2E"),
                    lataxis = list(showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#2A2A2E")),
         margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0)) |>
   htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el) {
      var lon = 20, paused = false, mode = 'globe';
      var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

      // Pause while the mouse is over the map (or briefly after a tap)
      el.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { paused = true; });
      el.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() { paused = false; });
      el.addEventListener('touchstart', function() {
        paused = true;
        setTimeout(function() { paused = false; }, 6000);
      });

      function showFlat() {
        mode = 'flat';
        Plotly.relayout(el, {
          'geo.projection.type': 'natural earth',
          'geo.projection.rotation.lon': 0,
          'geo.projection.rotation.lat': 0,
          'geo.showocean': false,
          'geo.lonaxis.showgrid': false,
          'geo.lataxis.showgrid': false
        });
      }

      function showGlobe() {
        mode = 'globe';
        Plotly.relayout(el, {
          'geo.projection.type': 'orthographic',
          'geo.projection.rotation.lon': lon,
          'geo.projection.rotation.lat': 10,
          'geo.showocean': true,
          'geo.lonaxis.showgrid': true,
          'geo.lataxis.showgrid': true
        });
      }

      // Expanded = the map fills most of the screen in both width and height
      function checkSize() {
        var expanded = el.clientWidth  > window.innerWidth  * 0.7 &&
                       el.clientHeight > window.innerHeight * 0.7;
        if (expanded && mode === 'globe') showFlat();
        if (!expanded && mode === 'flat') showGlobe();
      }

      var resizeTimer = null;
      new ResizeObserver(function() {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        resizeTimer = setTimeout(checkSize, 150);
      }).observe(el);

      // Slow turning, only in globe mode
      function spin() {
        if (mode === 'globe' && !paused && !reduceMotion &&
            document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
          lon = lon - 0.5;
          if (lon < -180) lon += 360;
          Plotly.relayout(el, {'geo.projection.rotation.lon': lon});
        }
        setTimeout(spin, 60);
      }
      spin();
    }
  ")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Crisis Severity vs. Media Attention"
plot_ly(scatter_data, x = ~attention, y = ~severity,
        text = ~label, customdata = ~country,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers+text", textposition = "top center",
        hovertemplate = "<b>%{customdata}</b><br>Severity: %{y:.1f}<br>News share: %{x:.0f}<extra></extra>",
        marker = list(color = scatter_data$dot, size = 11, opacity = 0.9,
                      line = list(color = gold_pale, width = 1)),
        textfont = list(color = text_light, size = 11, family = "DM Sans, sans-serif")) |>
  layout(paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
         font  = chart_font,
         xaxis = c(dark_axis, list(title = "News share (per 10k articles, log scale)", type = "log",
                                   tickvals = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000),
                                   ticktext = c("0.1", "1", "10", "100", "1,000"))),
         yaxis = c(dark_axis, list(title = "Crisis Severity Score")))
```

## Row {height=440px}

```{r}
#| title: "News attention: 8 most severe crises"
plot_ly(trend_data, x = ~month_lab, y = ~share_per_10k, color = ~name,
        colors = trend_colours, linetype = ~name, linetypes = trend_dashes,
        type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
        hovertemplate = "<b>%{fullData.name}</b><br>%{x}: %{y:.0f} per 10k articles<extra></extra>",
        line = list(width = 3), marker = list(size = 8)) |>
  layout(paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
         font   = chart_font,
         legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2, font = chart_font),
         xaxis  = c(dark_axis, list(title = "")),
         yaxis  = c(dark_axis, list(title = "Share per 10k articles", tickformat = ".0f")))
```

```{r}
#| title: "All countries"
reactable(neglect,
          searchable = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, compact = TRUE,
          defaultSorted = "severity", defaultSortOrder = "desc",
          columns = list(
            iso3       = colDef(show = FALSE),
            country    = colDef(name = "Country", minWidth = 110),
            severity   = colDef(name = "Severity", format = colFormat(digits = 1)),
            top_crisis = colDef(name = "Main crisis", minWidth = 160),
            crises     = colDef(name = "Crises"),
            attention  = colDef(name = "News share", format = colFormat(digits = 0)),
            funded_pct = colDef(name = "Funded", format = colFormat(suffix = "%"))
          ),
          theme = reactableTheme(
            color = text_light, backgroundColor = card_grey,
            borderColor = line_grey, highlightColor = line_grey,
            style = list(fontFamily = "DM Sans, sans-serif"),
            headerStyle = list(background = deep_grey, color = gold,
                               textTransform = "uppercase", letterSpacing = "0.1em",
                               fontSize = "0.72rem", fontWeight = 500),
            searchInputStyle = list(backgroundColor = deep_grey, color = text_light,
                                    borderColor = line_grey)
          ))
```

## Row

::: {.card title="About this data"}
::: {.about-text}
**Crisis Severity Score:** ACAPS INFORM Severity (o-10 scale), country level score, `r ref_label`.<br>
**Media attention:** each country's share of global online news coverage, GDELT Project, `r ref_label`.<br>
**Funding:** OCHA Financial Tracking Service, `r format(funding_date, "%Y")` appeals, year-to-date as of `r date_label(funding_date)`.<br>
**Coverage:** the `r nrow(neglect)` countries ACAPS reports in crisis in `r ref_label`.<br>
**Disclaimer:** ACAPS, the GDELT Project and OCHA are independent data providers. They are not affiliated with SA Analytical and do not endorse this dashboard. The analysis are SA Analytical's own.<br>
